utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I’m in the carpool—could Mara send me the time again? I seem to have misplaced it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Cleo’s checking the pickup time and will let me know, so I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear. I’m keeping my phone handy.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Nell — I’ll keep an eye out for it. I really appreciate you passing it along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it — I’ll check the pickup time and let Nell know. Once Bo sends the rider groups, I’ll make sure everything’s organized.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, 7:30 works for me too. Thanks for keeping it organized.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ve got 7:30 down, and I’ll keep an eye out for Bo’s rider groups so I can keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Faye can do pickup after school at 3:15. I’ll let her know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Rey can help with the carpool, and he can make the 8:15 tomorrow morning slot too. I can fill Dane in and lend a hand if you need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — that helps. I’ll keep Faye posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help on some weekdays around 7:30 to 8:00 a.m. and 3:00 to 3:30 p.m. Rosa’s organizing it, and I can repeat those times for Oren if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That would help a lot, thanks. I’m picking Mina up for the carpool, so I’ll make sure Oren has those times too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Sam — those weekday windows are 7:30 to 8:00 a.m. and 3:00 to 3:30 p.m. Let me know if you need anything else for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is the carpool still happening at the usual time? I’m not sure about the pickup timing, so I’d like to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, the carpool’s still on, and 8:15 seems to work best. Vik will pass the plan along to everyone so the whole group gets the same timing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks—so it’s still at 8:15? I just wanted to make sure the pickup timing is confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Rey’s all set for the carpool, and I’ll keep him posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, I’ll pick up Dane and Nora at 7:15.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, I’ll let Rey know you’ve got Dane and Nora at 7:15.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can take Tuesdays and Thursdays, and I’ll text when I’m on the way. Bo can cover the other days and keep an eye out for my text.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, that works for me. I’m still waiting on Rosa to confirm the pickup spot, but the 8:15 carpool for Mina and me is set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, that sounds good — just let me know when Rosa confirms the pickup spot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: 7:30 should work for me too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, 7:30 works. Cleo’ll keep the list and rider groups, and Ira can handle Tuesdays and Thursdays and text when on the way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Okay, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:15 works for me, and I can do pickup after school on Monday and Wednesday. Leo’s set for 3:15 too, so just let me know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I can help with the carpool, and I’ll keep an eye out for any changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rey — that’s a big help. If anything shifts, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll pass the carpool plan along to everyone, and Jules will make sure we’re all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — I’ll confirm the pickup spot and time and send Opal the details once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — I’ll keep everyone updated once you confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sam’s picking me up for the carpool, right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep — I’ll send the carpool schedule and loop Eli in too, so everyone has the details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. Just send me the schedule when you can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can check my schedule and the stops once you send the exact pickup list. Kira’s still waiting on the confirmation, right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep — Eli’s picking up me and Nora. I can send the exact pickup list now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, send it over and I’ll check whether my schedule and the route line up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with the carpool. Tess can keep me posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — once Quinn sorts the timing and pickup spots, I’ll check my schedule and the route to see if I can join.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good—just let me know what works once Quinn has it set, and I’ll stay in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can fill Dane in and lend a hand, and Rey can help with the carpool too. We’ve got it set for 8:15 tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still 8:15 tomorrow morning, right? I just want to confirm the pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yes, it’s still 8:15 tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll keep Rey posted about the carpool, and they should be ready for it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — 8:15 works best for the carpool, and Vik will pass the plan along so everyone gets the same update.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, I’ll make sure Rey knows it’s 8:15 and that they should be ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m double-checking the carpool time from Faye before I confirm anything to Kira.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll pass the carpool plan along to everyone once it’s set. Jules can help make sure we’re all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik — I’m just confirming the pickup time with Faye first, then I’ll let Kira know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sam’s picking me up for the carpool, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep — I can cover Tuesdays and Thursdays, and Bo’s got the other days. I’ll text when I’m on the way.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks — can you text me when you’re on the way?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, 7:30 works for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks — Eli’s picking up me and Nora, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think so — Eli’s doing the pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:15 works for me, and I can do pickup after school on Monday and Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll send the carpool schedule and loop Eli in if anyone wants a ride.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—3:15 still works for me, and I’ll wait for the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the carpool on some weekdays around 7:30 to 8:00 a.m. and 3:00 to 3:30 p.m.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: 7:30 should work for me too. Thanks, Mara.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — I’ll keep 7:30 in mind for the weekday carpool, and we can sort the afternoon window too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll pick up Dane and Nora at 7:15.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll grab Mina for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll stick to Dane and Nora at 7:15.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Leo — I’ll keep my phone handy and wait to hear from Cleo about the pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — Faye can do pickup after school at 3:15. I’ll let her know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect, thanks — I’ll wait for Cleo’s update and keep my phone close.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m confirming the pickup spot and time now, and I’ll send you the full carpool plan as soon as it’s set. Mara can also help on some weekdays around 7:30 to 8:00 a.m. and 3:00 to 3:30 p.m.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — I’m still set on the 8:15 carpool for Mina and me, so just send the pickup spot and time once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m on it and will send you the pickup spot and confirmed time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I’m in the carpool. Mara can send me the time again if needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep—Cleo’s handling the list and rider groups, and Ira’s got Tuesdays and Thursdays. Send the groups over when you can, and Ira will text when on the way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good—I’ll send the groups over, and if I forget the time again, Mara can text it to me.

injected.text: Update: the morning carpool now leaves at 8am from the church parking lot, not 7am from the school lot.
